title: Ginger porridge with rhubarb and hazelnuts

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Oats, milk, rhubarb, honey, hazelnuts, Greek yoghurt and ground ginger are all plain kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including the hazelnuts and forced rhubarb in March, is an everyday Tesco purchase.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only two saucepans and a wooden spoon, and the techniques are simple simmering and dry toasting.

works.reason: 200g oats in 1.2 litres of milk and water gives four proper bowls, and 400g of rhubarb with honey and a little water softens nicely in 5 to 8 minutes, though it will be on the tart side.

honest_times.reason: Toasting and chopping the nuts, cutting the rhubarb and stirring the porridge fit within 15 minutes of active work, and the 10-minute cook matches the parallel simmering.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and only water is added.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm porridge suits a chilly March morning, and the 400g of early rhubarb is clearly the point of the bowl.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a beginner can follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oats, fruit, yoghurt and nuts make a filling, real-food breakfast with only modest added honey.
